content:
A completed clean void sets the authorization to VOIDED and releases its hold without a principal debit. With no capture, there is no captured amount to refund.

The merchant's acknowledgement determines this outcome. A requested void may instead produce a partial capture; its actual captured and refundable fields then determine any reimbursement. Existing holds remain attached to their original funding accounts.
